cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(explorer_avif LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(VENDORED "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../upstream")
function(unpack_pinned archive expected destination)
    file(SHA256 "${archive}" actual)
    if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned source checksum mismatch: ${archive}")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${destination}/.verified-${expected}")
        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${destination}")
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${destination}")
        file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${destination}")
        file(WRITE "${destination}/.verified-${expected}" "${actual}\n")
    endif()
endfunction()

unpack_pinned("${VENDORED}/libavif-1.4.2.tar.gz" "2b645287340ba5a631d268b551dc2d72bd73ac33335962dd36dcdb6d8366921d" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/avif-source")
unpack_pinned("${VENDORED}/aom-3.14.1.tar.gz" "a1145ee86b9659734681e10bce91ebace21a93e443069c91eb28360d38a818fc" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/aom-source")

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/patch-sequences.cmake")

# Portable C implementations avoid an assembler requirement on Windows/macOS.
# Cargo's cmake helper forwards the target toolchain; never select host libraries.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AOM_TARGET_CPU generic CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_RUNTIME_CPU_DETECT 0 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_PIC 1 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LIBYUV 0 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_WEBM_IO 0 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
foreach(feature DOCS EXAMPLES TESTDATA TESTS TOOLS)
    set(ENABLE_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/aom-source" aom EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set_property(TARGET aom PROPERTY AVIF_LOCAL ON)

# The existing target satisfies SYSTEM without a system package lookup.
set(AVIF_CODEC_AOM SYSTEM CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
foreach(codec DAV1D RAV1E SVT AVM)
    set(AVIF_CODEC_${codec} OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(AVIF_LIBYUV OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(AVIF_LIBSHARPYUV OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(AVIF_BUILD_APPS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AVIF_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AVIF_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/avif-source/libavif-1.4.2" avif EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

add_library(explorer_avif_bridge STATIC bridge.c)
target_compile_features(explorer_avif_bridge PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_link_libraries(explorer_avif_bridge PRIVATE avif)
add_dependencies(explorer_avif_bridge avif_static)
target_include_directories(explorer_avif_bridge PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/avif-source/libavif-1.4.2/include")
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(explorer_avif_bridge PRIVATE /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(explorer_avif_bridge PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endif()
install(TARGETS explorer_avif_bridge avif_static ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
